picks.rationale: Lowe's beat Q3 estimates with adj. EPS of $3.10 vs $2.88 expected and raised full-year sales guidance to ~$92.5B; +12.35% in the past month, P/E 18.5, and a 2.26% dividend yield offer compelling value.
Home Depot posted a 2.2% comp sales beat vs Lowe's 1.8%, with stronger operating margins of 12.6% and a 2.75% dividend yield; +7.93% 1M, P/E 23.5, and analyst consensus 'buy'.
Chipotle surged +26.42% in the past month after Q3 comps rose 2.1% vs 1.5% consensus and September comps accelerated to +3.8%; P/E 33.2 reflects premium but momentum is strong.
McDonald's gained +10.96% in the past month, offers a 2.83% dividend yield, low beta of 0.43, and a reasonable P/E of 21.6; analyst consensus 'buy' with defensive appeal.
MGM Resorts reported record quarterly revenue in Macau with 17.1% market share and a favorable October rebound in Las Vegas; +12.09% 1M, P/E 12.5, and analyst 'buy' rating.
Tractor Supply reported Q3 net sales +5.1% to $3.91B, reaffirmed FY outlook, and saw sequential improvement in comps through the quarter; +17.59% 1M, P/E 20.7, and a 2.5% dividend yield.
PulteGroup gained +10.43% in the past month, trades at a low P/E of 13.3 with a 0.87% dividend yield, and benefits from resilient housing demand despite rate headwinds.
Domino's rose +12.04% in the past month, offers a 2.28% dividend yield, P/E 19.2, and analyst 'buy' consensus; value-oriented menu supports traffic in a cautious consumer environment.
Kingfisher gained +10.35% in the past month, YTD +19.96%, with a 3.27% dividend yield and P/E 21.1; benefits from home improvement demand in Europe.
Carvana gained +7.87% in the past month despite high short interest of 12.1% and beta of 3.65; analyst 'buy' consensus and potential for used-car demand recovery support the pick.
